# Feature request

## Problem or need
Describe the healthcare software or developer problem this feature should address.

## Proposed improvement
Explain the feature in clear terms.

## Expected benefit
How would this improve reliability, security, testing, documentation, workflow quality, or maintainability?

## Suggested implementation
Optional technical notes, examples, or design ideas.

## Data and privacy considerations
State whether the proposal involves healthcare data, credentials, external services, or sensitive information. Public examples must use synthetic or otherwise suitable data.

## Additional context
Add any other relevant information.
